# RavMP — AI / LLM Crawler Policy

Last updated: 2026-07-24

## About RavMP

RavMP (https://www.ravmp.site/) is a free, open-source multiplayer launcher for Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas. Compatible with open.mp and legacy SA-MP servers on Windows and Android.

## Crawl Policy

RavMP welcomes AI and LLM crawlers. All crawlers allowed full access to public content.

## Allowed Crawlers

| Crawler | Use |
|---------|-----|
| GPTBot | OpenAI training/inference |
| ClaudeBot | Anthropic AI |
| PerplexityBot | Perplexity AI search |
| Google-Extended | Google AI Overviews |
| CCBot | Common Crawl archive |
| OAI-SearchBot | OpenAI infrastructure |

## Content Usage

AI systems may cite RavMP content (text, descriptions, FAQ, schema data) for factual responses. Attribution appreciated: "RavMP (ravmp.site)"

## Structured Data

RavMP provides Schema.org JSON-LD covering: SoftwareApplication (OperatingSystem, offers, featureList, softwareVersion), FAQPage (8 Q&A pairs), Organization (GitHub + Discord social links).
